title: Enbeefened patch.

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 6 champion buffs, 3 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Enbeefened patch. Structured changes across 24 entities this patch.

champions.name: Akshan
champions.tldr: Base health reduced to 610 from 630.; Cooldown increased to 9–5 seconds from 8–5.
champions.gameplayImpact: Akshan loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

champions.name: Aurelion Sol
champions.tldr: Movement speed increased to 340 from 335.; Burst base damage increased to 60–100 from 55–95.
champions.gameplayImpact: Aurelion Sol is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Burst base damage
lines.note: Burst base damage increased to 60–100 from 55–95.

champions.name: Blitzcrank

champions.name: Jax

champions.gameplayImpact: Jax is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
